name: java-guide
Apply to `.java`, `pom.xml`, `build.gradle`, and Java-related requests. Java 17+, Spring Boot, Maven/Gradle, enterprise apps.

Standards: Prefer records, `final` fields, unmodifiable collections, composition, and standard-library APIs. Validate inputs at boundaries; use `Objects.requireNonNull`. Use explicit types; avoid raw types and unchecked casts. Use Java 17+ (LTS) with preview features disabled in production. Use Maven (`pom.xml`) or Gradle (`build.gradle.kts`); pin dependency versions (no dynamic versions). Follow [Google Java Style Guide](https://google.github.io/styleguide/javaguide.html). Use `PascalCase` classes, `camelCase` methods/fields, `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE` constants, lowercase packages. One top-level class per file, named for the file. Use `var` only when the type is obvious. No wildcard imports (`import java.util.*` is forbidden). Prefer records for immutable data carriers; use sealed types for restricted hierarchies and exhaustive pattern-matching switches. Validate records with compact constructors. Use streams for transformations, not side effects. Never call `Optional.get()` -- use `orElseThrow()`, `orElse()`, `map()`, `flatMap()`. Do not use `Optional` as a method parameter or field type (only as a return type). Avoid parallel streams unless measured faster; prefer `toList()` over `collect(Collectors.toList())`. Always use try-with-resources for `AutoCloseable` types. Never rely on `finalize()` (deprecated and unreliable). Close resources in reverse acquisition order. Prefer immutable factories/copies such as `List.of`, `Map.ofEntries`, and `List.copyOf`.

Project/testing: Use bounded-context packages; keep `resources/` flat and migrations in `db/migration/`. Suggested source root: `java/com/company/project/` (`Application.ja
